input.query: SELECT month, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE is_active) AS active_users, SUM(card_spend_eur) AS card_spend_eur, SUM(card_spend_eur) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE is_active),0) AS spend_per_active_user, SUM(n_card_txns) AS card_txns, SUM(n_card_txns) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE is_active),0) AS txns_per_active_user FROM fct_activity_monthly WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND month < DATE '2026-06-01' AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM dim_users WHERE country='Romania') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
